page_title: LIL 1-3 PSG | Lille v PSG 01/09/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' That's it for today, Benoit Bastien has blown his whistle and the game is over.
90+6' Jonathan David (Lille) has a goal ruled out for offside!
90+6' Lille have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.

90+1' 1 - 3 It's a goal! Randal Kolo Muani (PSG) bursts into the box to get on the end of a whipped in cross from Desire Doue and scores magnificently from close range into the bottom right corner. 1:3.
90+1' Bafode Diakite (Lille) shouldn't be surprised it's a yellow from the ref, who cooled the situation down well.
90' 5 additional min. will be played.
90' PSG take a short corner instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
89' What a chance that is! Desire Doue (PSG) finds himself unmarked in a promising position after receiving a cross on the edge of the box and his attempt sails a whisker wide of the right post.
85' Bruno Genesio prepares a substitution. Tiago Santos is replaced by Remy Cabella (Lille).
84' Gianluigi Donnarumma (PSG) is shown a yellow card by the referee.
83' A substitution has been made. Achraf Hakimi is replaced by Senny Mayulu (PSG).
83' The goal by Lille is DISALLOWED on the advice of the video assistant referee due to an offside.
83' That looked like an offside in the build-up play and the referee Benoit Bastien is going to take a look using VAR.
82' The assistant referee raises his flag and the referee blows his whistle. Tiago Santos (Lille) puts the ball into the net, but he is flagged for offside.
81' Desire Doue (PSG) brings his opponent down with a tackle and Benoit Bastien blows his whistle for a foul. Lille have been awarded a free kick.

78' 1 - 2 What a beautiful moment! Edon Zhegrova (Lille) got to the ball and unleashed a strong shot from distance. It turned out to be a good decision as his effort found its way into the bottom right corner. Gianluigi Donnarumma just shakes his head in disbelief. The score changes to 1:2.
77' The linesman signals that Alexsandro (Lille) is offside and the referee confirms the decision.
76' A player from PSG brings down an opponent and commits a foul. Lille earn a free kick which could lead to a goal-scoring opportunity.
75' Alexsandro (Lille) receives a precise low pass inside the box, controls it and sends it straight at Gianluigi Donnarumma, who makes a comfortable save.
74' Luis Enrique has decided to substitute Ousmane Dembele and he is replaced by Randal Kolo Muani (PSG).
74' It's time for a substitution. Kang-In Lee (PSG) comes on in place of Bradley Barcola.

73' Benjamin Andre (Lille) creates himself some space around the penalty spot and connects with the free kick. His header is badly mistimed and sails high over the bar. The ball goes out of play and PSG will have a goal kick.
73' Marquinhos (PSG) makes a slide tackle, but referee Benoit Bastien blows for a foul. Another situation results in a direct free kick for Lille.
71' Ousmane Dembele (PSG) receives a good pass just outside the box, unleashes a strike from a promising position, but the shot is blocked by the defender.

68' It looked like the long-range shot by Tiago Santos (Lille) would end up in the net, but the effort went slightly over the bar. The goalkeeper was quite lucky this time. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for PSG.
65' Substitution. Jonathan David (Lille) replaces Mohamed Bayo.
65' Here is a change. Aissa Mandi is going off and Bruno Genesio gives the last tactical orders to Thomas Meunier (Lille).
65' Luis Enrique decides to make a substitution. Joao Neves will be replaced by Fabian Ruiz (PSG).
65' Marco Asensio goes off the pitch and Desire Doue (PSG) comes on.
65' A pass by Tiago Santos (Lille) ends up in no man's land, and the attacking effort comes to an end. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for PSG.
61' Ousmane Dembele (PSG) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Lille.
59' Tiago Santos (Lille) misses a good chance to score. An inch-perfect cross into the box finds Tiago Santos (Lille) who rises for a header, but sends the ball well over the bar.

59' Achraf Hakimi (PSG) finds his teammate inside the box with a sweet pass. However, Ousmane Dembele wasn't able to finish and lost the ball. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Lille.
58' 1:6 – this is the current number of shots on target.
56' Edon Zhegrova (Lille) attempts to set up his teammate with a scoring opportunity by chipping in a fine pass from the edge of the box, but one of the defenders intercepts his effort.

54' Bradley Barcola (PSG) produced a promising shot low towards the middle of the goal after his wonderful solo run, but Lucas Chevalier thwarted him with a fabulous save and the score remains the same.
53' Marco Asensio (PSG) has a sight of goal and shoots towards the bottom left corner, but the goalkeeper makes a superb save.
52' Lille have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
52' Tiago Santos (Lille) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out. It will be a corner kick for Lille.

48' Mohamed Bayo (Lille) receives a brilliant pass and wastes a big opportunity as his shot from inside the penalty area flies narrowly wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and PSG will have a goal kick.
47' Ngalayel Mukau (Lille) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Benoit Bastien had an easy-decision to make.
46' The game is over for Angel Gomes (Lille). Ngalayel Mukau comes on for the second half.
46' Bruno Genesio has made a change at the break. Osame Sahraoui (Lille) has come on in place of Hakon Arnar Haraldsson.
46' The whistle blows and Benoit Bastien starts the second half.
45+6' The first half of today's match has just finished.
45+4' PSG control the tempo of the game by exchanging some accurate short passes.
45+3' The linesman raises his flag. Ousmane Dembele (PSG) is adjudged offside.
45' There will be a minimum of 5 min. of added time.
44' The linesman raises his flag as one of the players from Lille was in an offside position.
43' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Lille, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
42' Free kick. Lille will probably just try to cross the ball in from here.
41' There's a melee in the box, but the referee isn't interested in the appeals from Lille for a penalty. Play continues.
41' Gianluigi Donnarumma pulls off a great save to deny Tiago Santos (Lille), who makes himself some space inside the box and unleashes a quick shot towards the middle of the goal.
40' Edon Zhegrova (Lille) swings in the corner, but it's comfortably cleared away.
39' The ball is cleared after Edon Zhegrova (Lille) attempted to dribble past an opposing player. The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Lille.
36' 0 - 2 Bradley Barcola (PSG) connects with a pass inside the box and slams home into the bottom right corner. The goalkeeper was helpless.
36' The ball possession at the moment is 36:64.
33' 0 - 1 Goal! Vitinha (PSG) runs up to the ball, stops and waits for Lucas Chevalier to commit before slotting the penalty into the bottom left corner.
33' Vitinha (PSG) will take the responsibility and he is already preparing the ball.
31' Alexsandro (Lille) is booked by the referee.
31' Alexsandro (Lille) trips an opposition player and Benoit Bastien signals a foul. Penalty! A huge opportunity to score for PSG.
31' Tiago Santos (Lille) is adjudged offside.
30' Bradley Barcola (PSG) beats the defender to the lofted pass inside the box, but can't control his shot and it flashes high over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Lille will have a goal kick.
29' Gabriel Gudmundsson (Lille) pulls the jersey of one of the opposition players and Benoit Bastien blows his whistle for a foul.

27' Achraf Hakimi (PSG) put a cross into the box which wasn't a bad decision, but he failed to achieve what he wanted as none of his teammates managed to meet it. The ball has crossed the sideline. Lille are taking a throw-in.
25' Bradley Barcola (PSG) is deemed to be in an offside position by the linesman and it looks like it is the right decision despite being a very close call.
24' Lucas Beraldo (PSG) receives a yellow card from the referee for a foul that he committed a little earlier.
22' Bradley Barcola (PSG) jumps into a tackle and Benoit Bastien signals a foul. A free kick to Lille.
21' Edon Zhegrova (Lille) chips a pass over the line of defenders to get the ball to Mohamed Bayo, but his attempt is intercepted and cleared.
17' Ousmane Dembele (PSG) takes a wonderful touch after collecting a pass inside the box. He steers his shot goalwards, but the keeper produces a decent save!
12' Bafode Diakite (Lille) storms into the box to get on the end of a pass, but smashes his shot straight onto the right post. Unlucky!
12' Hakon Arnar Haraldsson (Lille) sent a pass onto Mohamed Bayo, who didn't get a chance to finish.
11' Warren Zaire-Emery (PSG) commits a rough foul. Benoit Bastien stops the game and makes a call.

9' Ousmane Dembele (PSG) beats a couple of players and hammers in a low shot from mid-range towards the middle of the goal. The keeper is caught unaware but still pulls off a great save to deny the effort.
8' Some great controlled play and passing from PSG. They are increasing their possession of the ball and trying to open up the opposition's defence to hit them swiftly on the break.
6' Ousmane Dembele (PSG) sends over a cross, but he can't find any teammate inside the box. Poor delivery. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Lille.
4' Marco Asensio (PSG) delivers a promising cross into the box, but it's cleared.
3' Ousmane Dembele (PSG) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
1' The match has just started.
The players are out at last! PSG will take the kick-off.
Benoit Bastien will supervise the game today.
